ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the left side is country Jia, marked at about 4°E and 52°N, bordering the North Sea to the northwest, located in northwestern Europe; the right side is country Yi, marked at about 40°E and the 0° latitude line, bordering the Indian Ocean to the southeast, located near the equator in East Africa. Then reason: Based on the position, it can be judged that country Jia is the Netherlands, and country Yi is Kenya. The question stem states that Jia and Yi are respectively traditional and emerging fresh-cut flower producing countries. Emerging producing countries such as Kenya usually rely on tropical natural conditions and low-cost competition, while the Netherlands, as a traditional fresh-cut flower producing country, relies on a mature industrial system, technology, and management, and can better maintain high quality in terms of products. Therefore, when the question asks about the advantage “in terms of products,” the answer should be that the quality of fresh-cut flowers is better.
